pickthall.translator: Marmaduke Pickthall, The Meaning of the Glorious Koran (1930), public domain

verses.text: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind
From the evil of the sneaking whisperer
Who whispereth in the hearts of mankind
Of the jinn and of mankind

yusufali.translator: Abdullah Yusuf Ali, The Holy Quran (1934), public domain

verses.text: Say: I seek refuge with the Lord and Cherisher of Mankind
From the mischief of the Whisperer (of Evil), who withdraws (after his whisper)
(The same) who whispers into the hearts of Mankind
